static_traits.name: Wang Dawei
static_traits.occupation: Pilot (recently promoted to a supervisory/administrative role)
static_traits.family_status: Both parents serve in the military; raising two beagles (Chance and Boomer)
static_traits.social_status: By their own account, relationships with colleagues may be affected by negative self-perception
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; has not experienced similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to Reflect; Low mood, mainly negating self-evaluations, often using labeling and black-and-white statements like 'I am not good enough' 'I am a failure'; Good cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: After receiving an unexpected promotion at Work, feeling like a failure as a Pilot, triggering disappointment and Self-doubt, and continuing to be troubled in Work and career thinking.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts and feelings are affecting mental health and overall job satisfaction, so I hope to relieve and improve them through counseling.
growth_experiences: Family of origin: Both parents serve in the military (grew up in a military family; materials Not mentioned its specific impact)

core_beliefs: I am a failure (as a Pilot)

special_situations.event: The company announces promotion to a supervisory/administrative position rather than the expected pilot-navigator position
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not obtained my set target position (lead flight), it shows I am not good enough and a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher standards and works harder to prove herself; tries to rationalize and focus on the positives, but finds it hard to sustain
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I did not get the promotion I wanted; as a Pilot I am a failure/I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking about work or career aspirations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must achieve the next step of the established career path, otherwise my career does not count as successful
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously ruminating and self-examining career goals to find inadequacies; avoiding discussing such feelings with parents
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have not succeeded in my career; all efforts were wasted

special_situations.event: Recalls past career achievements (such as successfully handling complex flights)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless reaching the ideal position, no other achievement counts
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles past successes to maintain high-pressure demands on goals
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those achievements are all unimportant now

special_situations.event: Views the current supervisory / administrative position as 'trapped in the office, regressing'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only continuously leading and teaching on the front line counts as career progress; administrative positions mean going backward
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Defines role worth with negative labels to keep a simplified evaluation framework
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This role is a step back, showing I am not suited to be a lead Pilot

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as an excellent and leadership-capable Pilot, with a controllable career path reflecting self-worth
core_conflict.fear: Fearing not being good enough, being negated, worrying about being seen as a failure and losing career meaning
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and certainty by evaluating himself against a single goal and high standards
Reducing the intensity of disappointment and vulnerable emotions through Intellectualization and negating the positive

object_relations.object_representation: The organization/others are internalized as strict judges or rejecters

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites attention to past achievements or the positive side
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that unless a specific goal is achieved, no achievement counts (treating affirmation as irrelevant)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First fully Empathy their disappointment, then gently point out specific facts and evidence; use open-ended questions to invite identifying the positive side; calm tone, avoiding confrontation and evaluation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing 'supervisory/administrative positions may also be another path of Career development'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing the current position entirely as 'regression/failure', unable to integrate good and bad together
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using contrast and continuum Questioning to help see the gray areas and multiple dimensions; supportive tone, slow, allowing pauses to hold emotions

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing how they handle disappointment and Anxiety (self-described as 'trying to rationalize and focus on the positive')
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses abstract analysis and logical self-persuasion to keep distance from emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Invites returning to present experience, concretizing body sensations and emotion words; reduces explanatory language, using a gentle tone and slow pace to promote emotional contact

manifestations: Binding career success to a single target position, viewing it as overall failure when not yet achieved
Feels disappointed about the non-ideal promotion; questions the value and meaning of past achievements
outcomes: Relationship with colleagues may be affected

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Viewing 'lead flight' as the next logical step of Career development and internalizing it as a must-achieve standard
Defines self-worth solely by external position standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly blaming myself: 'I am not good enough' 'I am a failure'
Measures himself by a single goal; worries relationships with colleagues will be affected by his self-evaluation

exception_events.target_problem: When Thinking about work or career ambitions, the client usually ruminates repeatedly and labels themselves a 'failure', with Low mood and WorkDecreased drive.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a past complex flight mission, successfully landed and handled complex situations, feeling proud and competent at the time (the old 'failure' reaction had not yet appeared).
exception_events.reason: Different situation and clues: that mission was challenging and completed successfully, bringing immediate experiences of competence and contribution, so it was not yet dominated by Self-denial.

positive_force: Once successfully handled a complex flight and experienced pride and competence
The organization gave a promotion, showing others recognize one's ability
Willing to try restructuring thinking and exploring the connection between new roles and long-term goals (has willingness to change)
negative_force: Negating the positive and mental filtering
High expectations and self-reproach causing stress and rumination

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated rumination and Self-denial (seeing myself as a failure as a Pilot)
antecedent: Thinking about work or career ambitions
target_behavior.core_reason: Defining overall career worth by a single target position, accompanied by black-and-white, overgeneralization, and negating-the-positive cognitive biases
target_behavior.function: Briefly escaping uncertainty and failure Anxiety, gaining a kind of 'interpretable certainty' through Self-denial
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and disappointment, Self-doubt, WorkDecreased motivation, Relationship with colleagues may be affected
